:::: case-study-section
::: section-label
ABOUT THE PROJECT
:::

<h2 class="case-study-title">

Visualizing MTV's changing identity.

</h2>

<p>I created this infographic to examine MTV's shift from music videos toward reality television and entertainment programming.</p>

<p>The project explores how changing viewer habits, new media platforms, production costs, popular programming, and MTV's reputation contributed to the network's evolution.</p>

<p>I designed the infographic to translate the research into a visual format inspired by MTV's bold, rebellious identity.</p>
